title: driver-sqlite-wasm: a text value does not round-trip the way driver-sql's does — an embedded NUL truncates the stored value, and a leading BOM is stripped on read
body:
Filing gate: **① a defect with a named landing site**: `SqliteWasmDriver` (`packages/drivers/driver-sqlite-wasm/src/sqlite-wasm-driver.ts`) and its sql.js bind/read path, which `SqlDriver` on better-sqlite3 does not share. Finding class **(a)**.

Filed by the `domain:engine` execution seat 1 (`session_01Bvd69VPa6puiNzzPUroDBx`) from the out-of-scope findings of its #19912 dev (report comment 5815478298 on #19912). ⛔ Filed bare: routing and grading are triage's. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What happens

The dev's scratch probe ran `create` then `findOne` on a plain `text` field, with driver dists built at PR #19972's head `74ff944`. The seat did not re-run it.

| value written | driver-sql on better-sqlite3: stored → read | driver-sqlite-wasm (sql.js): stored → read |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `'a'` + U+0000 + `'b'` | hex `610062` → `'a\u0000b'` | hex `61` (truncated) → `'a'` |
| U+FEFF + `'hello'` | hex `EFBBBF68656C6C6F` → verbatim | hex `EFBBBF68656C6C6F` (intact) → `'hello'` (BOM stripped) |

⇒ The sql.js face silently truncates a text value at an embedded NUL on write, and strips a leading BOM on read. Neither raises an error.

## Why it matters

- driver-sqlite-wasm is a published driver: the browser / edge SQLite face.
- The same value written through two SQLite faces of one `SqlDriver` family reads back differently.
- The NUL case is a silent write truncation (a durability degradation, AGENTS.md).

## Suggested shape (⛔ not a ruling)

Measure first where sql.js loses each byte (the bind of a JS string, or the result decode). Then either round-trip them exactly or refuse the value loudly, and pin the answer as a shared conformance cell (`FILTER_TEXT` / `VALUE_ROUNDTRIP` family), so the next face cannot differ silently.

## Filing-gate answers

- **Class**: ① (defect, named landing site); finding class (a), measured by the dev with a scratch probe.
- **Acting reader**: the seat that owns `packages/drivers/driver-sqlite-wasm` after triage routes it.
- **Dedupe**, MCP issue search in this repo, `closed` included: `sqlite-wasm sql.js embedded NUL truncated BOM stripped text round-trip` → 1 hit: #19912 (the parent, unrelated defect). `SqliteWasmDriver NUL byte text field stored truncated` → 6 hits: #19912, #16091, #12732, #11431, #11794, #6518 (all about varchar width or case folding). None is this defect.

Dedupe words: `sqlite-wasm embedded NUL truncated` · `sql.js BOM stripped on read` · `SqliteWasmDriver text round-trip U+FEFF` · `wasm driver NUL byte text field`
